about_the_game:
This digital artbook features the exclusive concept art of each V-Monster from V-Monsters Digital Farm! Dive into the creative process behind each design, including the inspirations and ideas that brought your favorite monsters to life.

Note: The artbook is only available in Portuguese, in .pdf format, located in the game's main directory.
